decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith (2346-01KG, 02KG, 03KG E, 04KG D, 05KG B, 06KGA and 07 received 01.10.12.) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the extensions and landing area for the external staircase hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Proposed basement and ground floor rear extensions to create additional Beauty Shop/Estate Agent space (basement and ground floor) and erection of rear roof extensions to create habitable rooms (upper floor)
